a260827p1.summary: By now you've almost certainly heard the news that Meta has settled with 52 state and local Attorneys General who had sued …
a260827p1.title: Meta's AG settlement gives it a moat to write child safety rules for other social media platforms, with little evidence its new safety features will help kids (Mike Masnick/Techdirt)

a260827p10.summary: In his ruling, which applies to only certain images, a federal judge asked the Supreme Court to revisit legal precedents that predated advances in AI.
a260827p10.title: A federal judge, in his US Court of Appeals ruling, urged SCOTUS to reconsider the issue of CSAM and revisit legal precedents that predated advances in AI (Nitasha Tiku/Washington Post)

a260827p11.summary: Artificial intelligence has made interpersonal skills more valuable, executives say — Consulting executives are considering ordering junior staff …
a260827p11.title: UK consulting executives say AI has made interpersonal skills more valuable, as the companies consider more office time for junior staff to hone them (Ellesheva Kissin/Financial Times)

a260827p12.summary: Earlier this year, we ran a pilot giving external researchers access to aggregate, real-world Claude usage data.
a260827p12.title: Anthropic releases findings from a pilot that let three external researchers run studies on Claude usage; one study found users delegate high-stakes tasks (Anthropic)

a260827p13.summary: Online fast-fashion retailer Shein is set to price its Hong Kong initial public offering near the midpoint of its marketed range …
a260827p13.title: Sources: Singapore-based Shein is set to price its Hong Kong IPO at ~$6.20, or near the midpoint of its marketed range, raising $1.73B and valuing it at ~$26.5B (Reuters)

a260827p14.summary: Meta, the social media giant, agreed to change the way children interact with its apps. That could be trouble if its competitors don't abide by the same rules.
a260827p14.title: YouTube and TikTok are yet to publicly acknowledge Meta's proposed changes under its AG settlement; some US lawmakers signal an appetite for industry-wide rules (Mike Isaac/New York Times)

a260827p15.summary: The pressure on Grand Theft Auto VI to deliver the holy grail of gaming is enormous - we talk to Rockstar's epic team of creative talents to uncover its secrets
a260827p15.title: Rockstar executives discuss GTA VI, including new interactive systems that let player habits like diet alter characters' appearance and in-game social media (Thom Waite/Dazed)

a260827p2.summary: The US government is investigating Singapore-based Apex Logistics for its suspected role in smuggling Nvidia Corp. AI chips to China …
a260827p2.title: Sources: the US is probing Singapore-based Apex Logistics for its suspected role in smuggling servers with Nvidia AI chips to China; Apex says it is cooperating (Bloomberg)

a260827p3.summary: Will significant changes to Facebook and Instagram be enough to beat back a global wave of bans? — For just under a year from 2022 to 2023 …
a260827p3.title: Meta is seeking to position itself as the industry leader in child safety through its settlement with AGs, while still refusing to admit any wrongdoing (Casey Newton/Platformer)

a260827p4.summary: Jensen Huang is feeling spendy. In the span of a few weeks, the Nvidia CEO has committed billions to deals and investments — with more potentially right around the corner.
a260827p4.title: Filing: Nvidia says it has $18B committed to equity investments for the rest of the fiscal year and held $47.9B in private companies as of late July (Geoff Weiss/Business Insider)

a260827p5.summary: Exclusive: Arturo Béjar, an ex-Facebook employee and whistleblower, said outcome ‘is not an all clear to say the product is safe’
a260827p5.title: Arturo Béjar, a key witness in state AGs' trial against Meta, says terms of the settlement are insufficient to protect young users; Meta rejects the criticism (Nick Robins-Early/The Guardian)

a260827p6.summary: This seems like a way for Google to help prevent scraping of its search results by third-party tools and AI companies …
a260827p6.title: Google starts rolling out the google.com/goto URL as a passthrough URL to help prevent scraping of its search results by third-party tools and AI companies (Barry Schwartz/Search Engine Roundtable)

a260827p7.summary: Porsche has signed a five-year contract worth 1.25 billion euros ($1.46 billion) for artificial intelligence …
a260827p7.title: Indian IT giant TCS agrees to acquire Porsche's IT consulting business, MHP, for €320M as part of a five-year, €1.25B contract to provide AI services to Porsche (Priyanka Salve/CNBC)

a260827p8.summary: The latest development will come as a welcome signal about the business model ahead of its possible IPO
a260827p8.title: Sources: DeepSeek is set to soon raise $7.4B at a $74B valuation from existing and new investors to fund R&D and its expansion into computing infrastructure (Wall Street Journal)

a260827p9.summary: A free app has propelled birdwatching into the mainstream, offering a portal to a hidden world.
a260827p9.title: A look at the Cornell Lab of Ornithology's Merlin Bird ID app, which has been downloaded 42M times since launching in 2014 and can identify 11,000 bird species (Claer Barrett/Financial Times)
